data.comment:
# Comfy Video Extend- Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash

Extend an existing video by up to 10 seconds per step, building stories up to 40 seconds total with Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash. The model analyzes the last 10 seconds of context, keeping characters, motion, and audio coherent as the scene continues from where it left off. Optionally attach reference images to introduce new characters mid-story. Works on uploaded clips and previously generated videos; describe how the scene should continue in plain language. Ideal for longer narratives, scene branching, and iterative storytelling. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_google_gemini_omni_flash_1_1_extend.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.model.prompt: Continue the scene: cut to a new shot at the edge of town, the two roosters taking a dust bath together in a shallow hollow of dry earth, hats set aside, wings kicking up clouds of golden dust that drift through the low sun, the earlier duel apparently forgotten. A tumbleweed rolls past in the background. The dramatic western score dissolves into a warm honky-tonk piano. Keep the same characters and live-action style consistent. Extend by 5 seconds.
